UnitStatement: The adapters/framework package provides format-neutral adapter framework checks for OpenPipeStress.

The adapter framework module validates already-declared adapter metadata and invented fixture payloads; it does not parse external file formats, access files or network resources, choose transport/runtime behavior, or make legal/professional determinations.
The package re-exports AdapterFinding, AdapterValidationResult, build_result, and validate_adapter_declaration from adapter_framework as its public API.
The DEL-10-02 adapter framework performs bounded in-memory validation and is deliberately format-neutral.

The framework checks adapter declarations and invented fixtures for no-bypass controls, provenance, unit metadata, privacy/export posture, and professional-boundary controls without parsing real external files or selecting a concrete import/export format.

REQUIRED_TBD_DECISIONS lists adapter/framework decisions that must remain TBD in DEL-10-02: external_format_list, public_transport_protocol, endpoint_syntax, adapter_execution_model, plugin_runtime, permission_grant_persistence, package_scripts, ci_provider, release_matrix, physical_project_container, local_fea_package_format, redaction_workflow.
REQUIRED_PROVENANCE_FIELDS requires source_name, source_location, source_license, contributor, contributor_certification, redistribution_status, and review_status.

REQUIRED_NO_BYPASS_TRUE defines mandatory no-bypass controls (e.g. must_use_public_api_boundary, must_preserve_provenance, must_not_access_network, must_not_claim_code_compliance) that adapters cannot disable.
REQUIRED_VALIDATION_PLAN requires schema_validation, unit_validation, dimension_validation, provenance_validation, redistribution_review, privacy_classification, and protected_content_screening.
FORBIDDEN_STATUS_TERMS bans authority terms CODE_COMPLIANT, CERTIFIED, SEALED, APPROVED_FOR_PROFESSIONAL_RELIANCE, SECURITY_CERTIFIED, and COMPLIANCE_ATTESTED from adapter payloads.

FORBIDDEN_PERSISTENCE_PATTERNS are regex patterns blocking direct persistence access such as raw SQLite handles, database connections, SQL strings, table names, and direct project-store mutation hooks.
The accepted privacy classification constant is public_permissive_reviewed (PUBLIC_REVIEWED).
AdapterFinding is a frozen dataclass with fields code, severity, path, message, and remediation.
AdapterValidationResult is a frozen dataclass with outcome and findings; accepted is True only when outcome equals ACCEPTED_FORMAT_NEUTRAL_DECLARATION.

validate_adapter_declaration validates a format-neutral adapter declaration payload by aggregating identity, framework-status, TBD-decision, adapter, validation-plan, operation-result, forbidden-term, and forbidden-persistence findings.
build_result builds a deterministic operation result envelope with parse_status not_parsed_by_framework, diagnostics, privacy posture, provenance, and professional_boundary.
The adapter operation result sets parse_status to not_parsed_by_framework, signaling the framework does not parse real external files.
The result privacy block sets local_first true, telemetry_allowed false, export_review_required true, and private_payload_redacted true.
invented_provenance returns a fixed provenance dict marking the fixture as project-invented test data with review_status accepted.
professional_boundary returns flags requiring human review, distinct mechanics-solve and user-rule-check, and all software compliance/certification/sealing/approval/security claims set false.
_validate_identity requires deliverable_id DEL-10-02, package_id PKG-10, scope_item SOW-030, and objective OBJ-009, emitting ADAPTER_TRACEABILITY_INVALID otherwise.
_validate_framework_status requires each TBD decision (except package_scripts) to equal TBD, emitting ADAPTER_RUNTIME_DECISION_NOT_TBD when a concrete runtime/transport/format choice is made.
Framework interface_kind must equal schema_first_format_neutral_adapter_framework, else ADAPTER_INTERFACE_KIND_INVALID.
_validate_tbd_decisions emits ADAPTER_TBD_DECISIONS_INCOMPLETE for missing keys and ADAPTER_DECISION_PREMATURE when a decision was resolved without a separate human ruling.
An adapter declaration whose format_status is not TBD triggers ADAPTER_FORMAT_SELECTED because concrete external formats must remain TBD in DEL-10-02.
Missing adapter capabilities trigger ADAPTER_CAPABILITIES_MISSING; adapters must declare bounded format-neutral capabilities.
Each validation-plan hook must equal 'required', else ADAPTER_VALIDATION_HOOK_MISSING; adapters cannot bypass validation, provenance, privacy, or protected-content hooks.
The validation plan must set human_review_required true, else ADAPTER_HUMAN_REVIEW_BOUNDARY_MISSING.
_validate_provenance emits ADAPTER_PROVENANCE_INCOMPLETE for missing fields and ADAPTER_PROTECTED_CONTENT_SUSPECTED (quarantine) when redistribution_status is protected_suspected.
_validate_privacy requires local_first true (ADAPTER_LOCAL_FIRST_REQUIRED) and telemetry_allowed false (ADAPTER_TELEMETRY_MUST_BE_DISABLED).
_validate_no_bypass emits ADAPTER_NO_BYPASS_CONTROL_DISABLED for any required control that is not True.
_validate_professional_boundary requires each professional_boundary flag to match expected values, else ADAPTER_AUTHORITY_BOUNDARY_VIOLATED; adapter outputs must remain decision-support artifacts.
_scan_forbidden_terms emits ADAPTER_FORBIDDEN_STATUS_TERM when any banned authority term appears in the payload.
_scan_forbidden_persistence_access emits ADAPTER_FORBIDDEN_PERSISTENCE_ACCESS when the payload exposes direct persistence access outside application-service commands/queries/jobs.
_determine_outcome returns QUARANTINE if any quarantine severity is present, REJECTED if any blocking severity is present, otherwise ACCEPTED_FORMAT_NEUTRAL_DECLARATION.
_diagnostic_class maps finding codes to PROVENANCE_WARNING, PRIVACY_WARNING, IP_BOUNDARY_WARNING, or ADAPTER_BLOCKING.
The analysis_runs package provides analysis-run record support for OpenPipeStress.
The package re-exports build_preview_analysis_run_envelope, canonical_json, and validate_analysis_run_envelope as its public API.
The records module builds immutable schema-shaped analysis-run records for DEL-14-02 from already-computed preview mechanics results.

The analysis-run record builder records provenance, diagnostics, result hashes, and professional-boundary flags; it does not run solvers, persist project files, evaluate code criteria, or make engineering acceptance claims.
Analysis-run records use SCHEMA_VERSION 0.1.0, DELIVERABLE_ID DEL-14-02, PACKAGE_ID PKG-14, SCOPE_ITEM SOW-072, and objective OBJ-016.
IMMUTABILITY_POLICY marks the run record read-only: changes create a new analysis run, a new run is required for any change, and the hash invalidates external acceptance.

PHYSICAL_PROJECT_CONTAINER profile is sqlite_local_project_store (decision SCA-003) acting as a local store index projection over the canonical JCS JSON payload, with no public SQL contract, no direct SQL access, no hosted DB, and no network required.
RUN_CONTRACT_STATUS binds analysis-run records to schemas/model_state.schema.json and schemas/results.schema.yaml, with external_validation_boundary reference_only_not_determined_by_software.

build_preview_analysis_run_envelope builds a deterministic DEL-14-02 wrapper around a preview mechanics result, taking refs for model state, settings, unit system, load basis, environment, solver, and build.

The analysis_run record captures run_id, run_kind mechanics_solve, solver_version with provenance, settings/unit/load refs, diagnostics, result_refs, hashes, analysis_status, reproducibility, immutability_policy, and professional_boundary.
Reproducibility records unresolved_tbd items including physical project container and release-grade solver build provenance.
validate_analysis_run_envelope returns blocking diagnostics for core DEL-14-02 invariant violations.

An analysis run must carry run_id, model_state_ref, solver_version, settings_ref, unit_system_ref, load_basis_refs, result_refs, hashes, analysis_status, immutability_policy, and professional_boundary, else ANALYSIS_RUN_FIELD_MISSING.
analysis_status must include HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED, else ANALYSIS_RUN_HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED_MISSING.
A professional_boundary mismatch emits ANALYSIS_RUN_PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY_VIOLATION; an immutability_policy mismatch emits ANALYSIS_RUN_IMMUTABILITY_POLICY_VIOLATION.
Each result_ref must carry hash_refs, else ANALYSIS_RUN_RESULT_HASH_MISSING.
canonical_json serializes values with sorted keys and compact separators (JCS-style) for stable hashing.
_result_ref builds a result reference with result_family, sha256 hash_refs over the result value, privacy_classification invented_public_example, and engine provenance.
_diagnostic_class classifies diagnostics by code into RULE_CHECK_BLOCKING/ASSUMPTION_WARNING, UNIT_WARNING, PROVENANCE_WARNING, SOLVE_BLOCKING, or RUN_REPRODUCIBILITY_WARNING.
_analysis_status always includes HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED plus any supplied mechanics and rule_check statuses.
_result_family classifies a result into displacement, reaction, force, moment, stress, ratio, or TBD based on its id or kind.
_checksum produces a sha256 JCS checksum record with algorithm, canonicalization, payload_ref, payload_scope, and value.
The analysis-run comparison engine compares already-available analysis-run and result-envelope records for diagnostic OpenPipeStress reviews.
The comparison engine does not ingest external solver files, define numerical acceptance defaults, or make professional/code-compliance determinations.
COMPARABLE_MAPPING_STATUSES are automatic_match and manual_match.
SUPPORTED_RESULT_FAMILIES are displacement, rotation, force, moment, reaction, stress, and ratio.
ComparisonDiagnostic is a frozen dataclass with code, severity, diagnostic_class, affected_refs, message, and remediation.
ResultDelta is a frozen dataclass capturing mapping/result ids, family, dimension, normalized unit, magnitudes, raw and normalized deltas, tolerance refs, and classification with basis.
SettingsDelta is a frozen dataclass with setting_key, left_value, right_value, and delta_kind.
AnalysisRunComparison aggregates comparison_id, run_context, result_deltas, settings_deltas, diagnostics, and professional_boundary, exposing has_blocking_findings.
compare_analysis_runs compares two analysis runs using explicit mappings and unit metadata, requiring caller-supplied mappings and conversions.
Analysis-run comparison output always sets human_review_required true and all software compliance/certification/sealing/approval/authentication claims false.
_compare_mapping computes a ResultDelta for one mapping or returns None with a diagnostic when the comparison cannot proceed.
A mapping whose status is not automatic_match or manual_match emits ARC-MAPPING-NOT-COMPARABLE and yields no delta.
A missing mapped result reference emits the blocking diagnostic ARC-RESULT-DATA-MISSING.
Unsupported or mismatched result families emit ARC-RESULT-FAMILY-UNSUPPORTED.
Incompatible or missing dimensions emit the blocking diagnostic ARC-DIMENSION-INCOMPATIBLE.
Missing unit metadata emits the blocking diagnostic ARC-UNIT-MISSING.
Non-finite or missing magnitudes emit the blocking diagnostic ARC-MAGNITUDE-MISSING.
Absence of an explicit conversion path emits the blocking diagnostic ARC-UNIT-CONVERSION-UNSUPPORTED; the engine never invents conversions.
A normalized delta is computed as right_normalized minus left_normalized after applying caller-supplied conversion factors.

_classify_delta returns not_classified unless a tolerance profile and matching numeric rule (with a normalized unit) are supplied; within or exceeds tolerance is decided against caller-supplied tolerance values.
_settings_deltas reports added, removed, or changed settings keys between left and right.
_numeric coerces a value to a finite float, returning None for bool, non-numeric, or non-finite values.
The model-state comparison engine performs deterministic model-state comparison for DEL-14-03.
The model-state comparison engine is provider-neutral: callers supply immutable model state records or references plus explicit entity payloads; analysis-run result deltas are out of scope.

METADATA_FIELDS enumerates the model-state metadata carried into comparison output (state ids, refs, tags, assumptions, warnings, status, hashes, immutability_policy, professional_boundary, provenance).
Model-state PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY notes that comparison output is deterministic decision-support output requiring external human review.
ModelStateComparisonError is raised when comparison input cannot be interpreted deterministically.
compare_model_states compares two model states and returns a deterministic diff envelope, accepting optional explicit mappings and settings.
Each entity must expose a stable identifier via stable_id, entity_id, id, ref, or reference.ref.
Entities sharing a stable_id on both sides are compared directly; explicit mappings then match remaining entities; leftover left/right entities are reported as removed/added.
A mapping overlapping an already-matched stable identifier emits DUPLICATE_MAPPING_BASIS and is skipped.

Comparison output reports comparison_kind model_state_to_model_state, engine DEL-14-03_model_state_comparison_v1, state refs, summary, entity rows, metadata, diagnostics, professional_boundary, and provenance.
_state_view accepts either a raw model_state object or a wrapper with model_state plus an entities list, raising ModelStateComparisonError on malformed input.
_entity_index raises if an entity is not an object, lacks a stable identifier, or has a duplicated stable identifier within one side.
_mapping_pairs supports only entity mapping records, emitting UNSUPPORTED_MAPPING_CATEGORY for other kinds.
A mapping that is unresolved or omits a counterpart emits MAPPING_UNRESOLVED; a mapping referencing an absent entity emits MAPPING_TARGET_MISSING.
A mapping status that is not manual_match or automatic_match emits UNSUPPORTED_MAPPING_STATUS.
_changes reports field-level differences between two entities, ignoring identifier keys, using canonical JSON for equality.
_unit_diagnostics emits MISSING_UNIT_METADATA, INCOMPATIBLE_DIMENSION, or INCOMPATIBLE_UNIT (all blocking) for changed unit-bearing fields lacking compatible unit/dimension metadata.
_category_diagnostic emits UNSUPPORTED_CATEGORY when compared entity categories are not both in the allowed comparable set or do not match.
_state_metadata_diagnostics surfaces unresolved assumptions (UNRESOLVED_STATE_ASSUMPTION), preserved warnings (STATE_WARNING_PRESERVED), and a PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY_NOTICE per state.
_stable_id resolves an entity identifier from reference.ref or stable_id, entity_id, id, or ref.
_has_unit_metadata is true only when the value is a dict with non-empty unit and dimension.
_row_id builds a deterministic row id from the mapping id or the left:right id pair, sanitizing non-alphanumeric characters.
utc_timestamp returns an explicit second-resolution UTC ISO timestamp for callers that do not require replay hashes.
The constraints/validation package provides deterministic constraint validation diagnostics.
The package re-exports Diagnostic, ValidationResult, diagnostic_dicts, and validate_constraint_envelope from its engine.
The constraint validation engine validates supplied OpenPipeStress design knowledge and emits decision-support diagnostics only.

Constraint validation checks supplied records and design-knowledge references for explicit evidence, provenance, assumptions, unit metadata, and represented conflict classes; it does not compute final technical approval or infer missing owner/code criteria.
SUPPORTED_SOURCE_TYPES are user, project, import, agent, and source_derived.
KNOWN_KINDS of constraints include connectivity, clearance, no_go_volume, support_zone, route_conflict, slope, drain, vent, access, equipment_interface, and missing_required_data.
CONFLICT_CLASS_BY_KIND maps constraint kinds to conflict classes such as CONNECTIVITY_CONFLICT, CLEARANCE_CONFLICT, ROUTE_CONFLICT, SUPPORT_ZONE_CONFLICT, and SLOPE_DRAIN_VENT_CONFLICT.
MIN_TARGETS_BY_KIND requires connectivity constraints to have at least 2 target references and most other kinds at least 1.
KINDS_REQUIRING_DESIGN_KNOWLEDGE require explicit design-knowledge references: clearance, no_go_volume, support_zone, route_conflict, slope, drain, vent, access, and equipment_interface.
KINDS_REQUIRING_PARAMETERS (clearance, slope, drain, vent, access) require explicit parameter evidence.
CANONICAL_DIMENSIONS enumerates the accepted PKG-02 dimension vocabulary (e.g. length, force, moment, pressure, stress, slope, linear_stiffness, rotational_stiffness, second_moment_area) plus TBD.
PROVENANCE_FIELDS requires source_name, source_location, source_license, contributor, contributor_certification, redistribution_status, review_status, and privacy_classification.
PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY_FIELDS are human_review_required and the five software_makes_* claim flags.
Diagnostic is a frozen dataclass: a stable provenance-aware validation diagnostic with code, severity, class, affected/source references, message, and remediation.
ValidationResult holds a tuple of diagnostics and exposes has_blocking_findings.

validate_constraint_envelope validates supplied constraints against available design knowledge, accepting raw mapping data so missing fields become explicit findings rather than exceptions or hidden defaults.
A missing constraint envelope emits the blocking diagnostic CV-MISSING-CONSTRAINT-ENVELOPE.
The constraint envelope must carry schema_version, deliverable_id, package_id, scope_items, objectives, data_boundary, and constraint_set, else CV-SET-MISSING-FIELD.
Each constraint record is validated individually; non-object entries emit the blocking CV-CONSTRAINT-INVALID-RECORD.

_validate_constraint_record validates one constraint record's required fields, provenance, professional boundary, source type, kind, targets, design knowledge, parameters, assumptions, and validation status.
An unsupported source_type emits CV-CONSTRAINT-SOURCE-UNSUPPORTED.
An unknown constraint kind emits CV-CONSTRAINT-KIND-UNSUPPORTED, and a TBD kind emits CV-CONSTRAINT-KIND-TBD.
Insufficient target references for a kind emit CV-<KIND>-TARGETS-MISSING.
Kinds requiring design knowledge with no design_knowledge_refs emit CV-<KIND>-DESIGN-KNOWLEDGE-MISSING.
Kinds requiring parameters with none supplied emit CV-<KIND>-PARAMETERS-MISSING; no engineering threshold is inferred.
A constraint reporting validation_status conflict_detected, missing_data, or blocked_by_missing_data is preserved as a diagnostic for human review.
_check_boundary requires data-boundary fields to match the expected public contract values, with protected_source_policy and engineering_authority mismatches being blocking.

The expected data boundary requires invented_or_cleared_data_only public examples, no bundled protected owner/standards data, user-controlled private paths, explicit unit metadata, and human review required outside software.
_check_provenance emits provenance field-missing warnings, a redistribution review (blocking for protected_suspected), and a privacy review for private/protected/redacted classifications.
_check_professional_boundary requires human_review_required true and all software_makes_* claim fields false, else IP_BOUNDARY_WARNING diagnostics.
_check_design_refs emits CV-DESIGN-REF-UNRESOLVED when a constraint references design knowledge absent from the supplied envelope.

_check_parameters validates parameter list shape and, for quantity value kinds, delegates to quantity checks; quantity-shaped values with non-quantity value_kind emit CV-PARAMETER-QUANTITY-KIND-MISMATCH.

_check_quantity requires value, unit, dimension, and provenance; missing fields emit CV-UNIT-METADATA-MISSING and unknown dimensions emit CV-UNIT-DIMENSION-UNKNOWN; the validator never converts units or invents tolerances.
_check_assumptions emits CV-ASSUMPTION-UNRESOLVED for unresolved or TBD assumptions.
The gui/accessibility package provides accessibility and usability baseline contracts for DEL-07-06.
The package re-exports PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY, build_accessibility_usability_baseline, and canonical_json.
The accessibility engine builds deterministic accessibility/usability baseline records for DEL-07-06.

SURFACE_NAMES maps PKG-07 deliverables to GUI surfaces: viewport_editor, model_tree_property_inspector, material_component_rule_pack_editors, missing_data_warning_ux, results_viewer, and solve_execution_ux.
Accessibility outcomes are pass, warning, fail, and not_applicable; severities are info, minor, major, and blocking.
Public privacy classes are invented_public_example and public_metadata; reference-only is private_reference_only.

PROTECTED_CONTENT_MARKERS detect restricted phrases (assembled at runtime) such as allowable stress table, stress intensification factor table, vendor catalog value, code compliant, accessibility certified, and professionally approved.
build_accessibility_usability_baseline builds a deterministic contract-level accessibility/usability review.
The accessibility reviewer consumes already-built GUI contract records; it does not run a desktop GUI, mutate source records, infer missing engineering data, or assert a final accessibility target.
The baseline output sets accessibility_target_status TBD_by_human_project_authority and desktop_runtime_evaluation not_performed.

The review_policy records that the reviewer does not auto-fill missing data, does not mutate GUI contract records, preserves diagnostics/assumptions/provenance/privacy, and makes no accessibility conformance claim.
_review_surface dispatches each GUI contract record to a per-deliverable reviewer (viewport, model tree, editors, warnings, results, solve execution) by deliverable_id.

_review_viewport checks the viewport surface for active-tool keyboard path, command-intent focus order, reversible undo/redo continuity, readable primitive labels, and warning visibility not conveyed by color alone.
_review_model_tree checks tree-node keyboard path, selection-to-property-inspector focus continuity, readable field labels, and visible units for numeric fields.

_review_editors checks editor keyboard path and labels, requires save_intent.mutates_persistent_project to be false (blocking otherwise), and requires private library data kept as references and checksums only.
_review_warnings requires each warning to expose class, severity, message, and remediation, and keeps blocking-warning summaries synchronized with detail rows.
_review_results requires result views to expose value_id, numeric_value, and unit columns, keep unresolved TBD results explicit, and pair overlays with a recorded non-color style token.

_review_solve_execution checks that solve timelines expose state, progress, and message feedback, keep non-terminal states visible until completion/cancellation/failure, and keep cancellation reachable without direct solver-process mutation.
_review_required_surface_coverage emits a finding per required baseline surface indicating whether an invented GUI contract record is present.
_review_workflow_continuity checks that model creation, missing-data review, solve feedback, assumptions, and result review surfaces are connected.
_review_runtime_boundary records that desktop accessibility-tree tooling is not performed and the human-selected accessibility target remains TBD.
_review_source_diagnostics keeps upstream diagnostics visible in the review path, marking blocking-severity source diagnostics as fail.
_review_professional_boundary walks the record requiring human_review_required true, all software_makes_* false, and professional_boundary_preserved true.
_review_provenance_and_privacy requires visible provenance and explicit privacy classifications, failing when a disallowed (non-public, non-reference-only) classification appears.
_review_content_boundary fails when any protected-content marker appears in the record text, keeping public GUI review records limited to invented or redistributable metadata.

_append_finding builds a finding with category, outcome, severity, source surface, affected control, remediation, sorted evidence refs, and a deterministic AUB- finding_id hashed from the finding content.
_stable_findings deduplicates findings by finding_id and returns them sorted by canonical JSON.
_walk_key_values recursively yields (path, key, value) triples over nested mappings and lists for boundary/provenance/privacy scanning.
The gui/design_workspace package provides design-authoring and comparison workspace contracts for DEL-07-08.
The package re-exports build_design_authoring_comparison_workspace and canonical_json.
design_workspace/engine.py provides deterministic design-authoring and comparison workspace records for DEL-07-08.

The design workspace is a GUI-facing composition layer that consumes already-available contract records and returns inspectable panel state; it does not mutate accepted model state, execute solvers, or turn comparison output into professional acceptance.
WORKSPACE_VERSION constant is '0.1.0' for the design workspace schema.
PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY requires human review and disclaims software compliance, certification, sealing, approval, and authentication claims.

DATA_BOUNDARY policy: public examples use invented or cleared data only; no bundled protected owner/standards data; private data by references and redacted metadata only; unit-bearing values require explicit unit metadata.

build_design_authoring_comparison_workspace builds a deterministic GUI workspace record from upstream contracts keyed by workspace_id with optional design knowledge, constraint validation, warnings, model states, analysis runs, comparisons, tolerance profile, operation preview/audit, and selected refs.
The workspace record carries deliverable_id DEL-07-08, package_id PKG-07, scope_item SOW-076, and objectives OBJ-015 and OBJ-016.

Workspace mutation_boundary asserts the workspace does not mutate accepted model state, has no hidden mutation, routes GUI-originated changes only through structured operation or application-service command intents, and requires an explicit user acceptance record for accepted operations.
build_design_authoring_comparison_workspace computes a workspace_hash over composition panels via _hash_payload.
canonical_json serializes workspace records with stable key ordering using sorted keys, compact separators, and ASCII escaping.
_design_knowledge_panel composes the design knowledge panel, emitting a WORKSPACE-DESIGN-KNOWLEDGE-MISSING warning and unavailable_missing_input panel when input is absent.
_design_record normalizes a design knowledge record, emitting WORKSPACE-DESIGN-RECORD-NOT-OBJECT (blocking) when the record is not a structured object.
A design record's unresolved_assumption_ids are assumption ids whose status is 'unresolved' or 'TBD'.
_constraint_warning_panel composes constraint validation and warning UX contract output, emitting warnings when either input is unavailable.
The constraint warning panel marks has_blocking when validation reports has_blocking_findings or any diagnostic/warning has blocking severity.
_state_run_browser builds model-state and analysis-run browser rows and emits WORKSPACE-MODEL-STATES-MISSING / WORKSPACE-ANALYSIS-RUNS-MISSING warnings when empty.
_model_state_browser_row builds a deterministic model-state browser row capturing state ref, kind, analysis status, hashes, hash boundary, immutability, and review/privacy classification.
Model-state immutability defaults to snapshot_is_read_only True with mutation_policy 'changes_create_new_model_state'.
_analysis_run_browser_row builds a deterministic analysis-run browser row capturing run ref, kind, model-state ref, result refs, analysis status, diagnostics, and hash boundary.
_state_run_hash_boundary records DEL-02-05 hash evidence per state/run row and emits WORKSPACE-MODEL-STATE-HASH-MISSING / WORKSPACE-ANALYSIS-RUN-HASH-MISSING warnings for rows lacking hashes.
Human acceptance is invalidated because hash-bound external records do not survive a payload-hash change; workspace hash scope is ui_composition_review_state_only.
State/run browser inherits PKG-14 model state and analysis run records and PKG-16 operation audit records.
_comparison_tables composes model-state and analysis-run comparison tables plus mapping-contract and tolerance-profile summaries.
_model_comparison_table builds comparison rows and an unmatched_rows subset for added, removed, unresolved, or unresolved-mapping classifications.
_analysis_comparison_table builds analysis result and settings delta rows and reports has_blocking_findings.
_analysis_result_row normalizes a result delta row with mapping id, result family, classification, tolerance refs, unit, dimension, magnitudes, and normalized delta.
_graphical_overlays builds descriptor-only overlays from model comparison, analysis comparison, and operation preview rows; overlay_policy is descriptor_only_no_solver_or_geometry_generation.
_model_overlay produces a model_state_delta overlay; it is visible by default unless classification is unchanged or mapped_unchanged.
_analysis_overlay produces an analysis_result_delta overlay bound to upstream result object refs (descriptor only) with visual review support only.
_operation_overlay produces an operation_diff_preview overlay visible by default only when preview_status is 'previewed'.
_operation_diff_review composes operation diff-preview rows joined with audit records, emitting warnings when preview or audit input is missing.
operation_diff_review operation_policy asserts the workspace does not apply operations, does not mutate accepted state, and requires explicit user acceptance before labelling an accepted operation.
_operation_review_row joins a preview row with its audit decision and emits WORKSPACE-OPERATION-MUTATION-SIGNAL-BLOCKED (blocking) when application_status is not 'not_applied'.
An operation can be represented as an accepted operation only when the audit decision is accepted, has explicit user acceptance, and did not mutate accepted model state.
Operation review rows force workspace_application_status to not_applied and accepted_model_state_mutated_by_workspace to False.

_operation_review_state maps audit decision and preview status to review states: explicit_user_acceptance_recorded, rejected_operation_recorded, held_for_user_acceptance, blocked_by_validation, preview_ready_for_user_review, or preview_unavailable.
_review_state_routing computes route_state as blocked_findings_visible when blocking diagnostics exist, input_unavailable_review when panels are unavailable, else review_navigation_available.
_mapping_contract_summary summarizes a comparison mapping contract with mapping_count and unmatched_count.
_tolerance_profile_summary summarizes a tolerance profile with profile ref, status, and rule_count.
_diagnostic assigns contract_ref DEL-02-05 when the code contains 'HASH', otherwise DEL-02-03.
_contains_tbd recursively detects the literal 'TBD' in strings and treats None values as unresolved TBD.
_hash_payload returns a sha256: prefixed hash over canonical JSON of the value.
editors package exposes material, component, and rule-pack editor contracts for DEL-07-03.
editors/__init__ exports build_editor_contract and canonical_json.
editors/engine.py provides deterministic editor contracts for DEL-07-03.
EDITOR_KINDS are 'material', 'component', and 'rule_pack_reference'.
build_editor_contract builds deterministic material/component/rule-pack editor records keyed by editor_set_id for DEL-07-03 / PKG-07 / SOW-021 / OBJ-006.
Editor contract command_policy is bounded apply/cancel intents only and private_payload_policy keeps references and checksums only with no private payload copy.
_editor_record emits EDITOR_KIND_UNSUPPORTED (blocking) for an unrecognized editor kind and RULE_PACK_CHECKSUM_MISSING (blocking) when a rule_pack_reference lifecycle lacks a checksum.
An editor save_intent has status pending_service_validation and mutates_persistent_project False.
_field_record validates a field, blocking on missing unit/dimension metadata and marking unresolved_TBD when value is None or 'TBD'.
_validation_state returns blocked when no fields, blocked_by_unresolved_fields for unresolved fields, blocked_by_contract_metadata for blocked fields, else ready_for_service_validation.
model_tree package exposes model tree and property inspector contracts for DEL-07-02.
model_tree/__init__ exports GUI_PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY, build_model_tree_property_inspector, and canonical_json.
model_tree/engine.py provides deterministic model-tree/property-inspector records for DEL-07-02.
build_model_tree_property_inspector builds a deterministic GUI tree and inspector record from project_id, entities, and an optional selected_ref.
The model-tree function only shapes invented or already-cleared GUI state; it does not mutate project data, persist edits, run solvers, or fill missing values.
Model-tree mutation_policy is application_service_command_intents_only.
_tree_node builds a tree node and emits MODEL_TREE_ENTITY_INCOMPLETE (blocking) for incomplete entities and PROPERTY_VALUE_UNRESOLVED (warning) for unresolved property values.

provenance_checker.py validates already-parsed material, section, and component library payloads at the import boundary.

The provenance checker projects import findings into a PKG-02-style diagnostic envelope.

The provenance checker does not parse external file formats and does not make legal conclusions about licenses or redistribution rights; unresolved rights remain review findings for the human project authority.
The open_pipe_stress_library_import_document crate (version 0.1.0, edition 2021) is the runtime Rust port of the DEL-03-07 provenance-checker contract for library-import payload validation.

The library-import document crate makes no professional, certification, sealing, authentication, or code-compliance claims and performs no external file-format parsing or legal license determinations.
The library-import document crate depends on serde (with derive) and serde_json version 1.
open_pipe_stress_library_import_document is a runtime validation seam for material, section, and component library import payloads.

The library-import document crate is the runtime Rust port of the DEL-03-07 import provenance contract; provenance_checker.py is the design authority and the crate reproduces its semantics for the Tauri/Rust desktop runtime.

At the already-parsed payload boundary the crate checks required provenance fields, redistribution/review disposition for public imports, private-only data handling, suspected protected-content quarantine, unit/value-level provenance, and PKG-02-style diagnostic envelope projection.

The crate does not parse external file formats or make legal license/redistribution determinations; no status it emits is a professional, certification, sealing, authentication, or code-compliance claim — every status is a software finding only.
Public API: validate_library_import(payload, library_kind, intended_visibility) returns an ImportValidationResult.
The seam entry point validate_library_import_tokens(payload, material|section|component, public|private) returns Err for unsupported tokens and never guesses.
ImportValidationResult carries outcome, library_kind, intended_visibility, accepted, and findings, with diagnostics() projecting findings into the PKG-02 envelope.
An import outcome is one of QUARANTINE, REJECTED, REVIEW_REQUIRED, PRIVATE_LOCAL_ONLY, or ACCEPTED_PUBLIC, in that severity precedence order.
tests/provenance_parity.rs mirrors tests/test_library_import_provenance.py one-for-one over the same invented fixtures, guarding against silent divergence between the Rust and Python implementations.
The library-import provenance validation seam (lib.rs) is the runtime port of DEL-03-07 validating already-parsed material/section/component import payloads at the import boundary.

Like the Python contract, the Rust crate does not parse external file formats or make legal license/redistribution determinations, and emits only software findings, not professional/certification/sealing/authentication/code-compliance claims.

Redistribution status constants: PUBLIC_OK_REDIS_STATUS is public_permissive, PRIVATE_REDIS_STATUS is private_only, and PROTECTED_REDIS_STATUS is protected_suspected.
LibraryKind enum (Material, Section, Component) mirrors the Python RECORD_KEYS dispatch table.
LibraryKind::from_token parses material/section/component tokens and returns None for unsupported kinds rather than guessing.
Each LibraryKind maps to a (library_metadata_key, records_array_key) pair, e.g. material_library/material_records.
IntendedVisibility enum (Public, Private) mirrors the Python intended_visibility argument and parses public/private tokens.
ImportFinding carries code, severity (blocking|quarantine|review_required), path, message, and remediation, mirroring the Python ImportFinding dataclass.
ImportFinding::to_diagnostic projects a finding into the PKG-02 import-boundary diagnostic envelope shape.
ImportValidationResult carries outcome, library_kind, intended_visibility, accepted, and findings, mirroring the Python ImportValidationResult.

validate_library_import validates provenance and redistribution controls; public imports must carry accepted public-permissive provenance, while private imports may remain local but cannot bypass protected-content quarantine or missing-provenance findings.

provenance_parity.rs cross-language parity tests mirror test_library_import_provenance.py one-for-one over the same invented fixtures so the Rust port and Python contract agree on outcome and finding codes.
Test: a public component import with accepted public-permissive provenance is accepted with outcome ACCEPTED_PUBLIC and no findings.

Test: a private material import with TBD rights can remain local with outcome PRIVATE_LOCAL_ONLY and no IMPORT_REDIS_RIGHTS_MISSING.
Test: missing record provenance blocks import (outcome REJECTED) with IMPORT_PROVENANCE_MISSING and no silent defaults.

Test: removing unit metadata from an imported value yields outcome REJECTED with IMPORT_UNIT_METADATA_MISSING.

Test: import findings map to the PKG-02 diagnostic envelope with class import_boundary, the diagnostic source, an affected_object path, non-empty remediation, and provenance source_name library_import_payload.

REQUIRED_PROVENANCE_FIELDS (Python) are source_name, source_location, source_license, contributor, contributor_certification, redistribution_status, and review_status.
Redistribution status values: PUBLIC_OK_REDIS_STATUS public_permissive, PRIVATE_REDIS_STATUSES {private_only}, UNKNOWN_REDIS_STATUSES {unknown, TBD, None}, PROTECTED_REDIS_STATUS protected_suspected.
RECORD_KEYS maps each library kind to its (library_metadata, records) key pair: material, section, and component.
ImportFinding dataclass carries code, severity, path, message, remediation, diagnostic_class (default import_boundary), source, affected_object, and provenance.
ImportFinding.to_diagnostic maps an import finding into the PKG-02 diagnostic envelope shape.
ImportValidationResult carries outcome and findings; accepted is true only for ACCEPTED_PUBLIC or PRIVATE_LOCAL_ONLY outcomes.
validate_library_import raises ValueError for unsupported library_kind or intended_visibility, validating provenance and redistribution controls per public/private intent.
Finding IMPORT_LIBRARY_METADATA_MISSING (blocking) fires when the library metadata object is missing.
Finding IMPORT_RECORD_SET_MISSING (blocking) fires when the library record array is missing.
Finding IMPORT_RECORD_INVALID (blocking) fires when a library record is not an object.

Finding IMPORT_PROVENANCE_INCOMPLETE (blocking) fires when required provenance fields are missing.
