The open_pipe_stress_load_case_algebra crate (version 0.1.0, edition 2021) provides code-neutral load case algebra for OpenPipeStress and depends on open_pipe_stress_primitive_loads.
The load_case_algebra crate is the bounded implementation slice for DEL-05-02 that combines explicit mechanics operands from primitive load cases or result states.
Load case algebra provides no protected design-code combinations, public default factors, rule-pack expression evaluation, stress recovery, or professional/code-compliance claims.
Load case algebra scope includes user-defined linear combination terms with explicit numeric factors.
Load case algebra scope includes result-state subtraction and min/max range envelopes over compatible mechanics quantities.
Load case algebra performs dimension compatibility checks using the existing primitive-load dimension vocabulary.

Load case algebra result boundary records require explicit unit metadata, provenance reference, result-schema binding, JCS payload reference, and payload-hash reference before quantities are handed to persistence or result envelopes.
Load case algebra preserves analysis status for mechanics-solved, rule-input-incomplete, user-rule-checked, user-rule-failed, and human-review-required states.

Load case algebra emits deterministic findings for missing operands, non-finite factors, unsupported expression shapes, dimension mismatches, duplicate operands, missing result states, and professional-boundary violations.

Load case algebra does not implement a general expression parser, the rule-pack expression evaluator, code-specific load-combination defaults, wind/seismic procedures, stress-recovery formulas, protected standards content, proprietary project data, report rendering, GUI behavior, or headless execution.

Load case algebra inputs are explicit mechanics/result quantities already governed by upstream schemas, units, provenance, and load/status boundaries; unsupported semantics remain deterministic findings or TBD decisions, not silent defaults.

The load case algebra API rejects load-record schema bindings for result quantities; successful result boundary records bind to the canonical model result value or schema-first result-envelope quantity surface.
Load case algebra records payload and hash references only; it does not compute hashes, choose conversion constants, or define code-specific calculation units.

Load case algebra unit tests cover linear combinations, result-state subtraction, range envelopes, dimension compatibility, missing/invalid operands, duplicate operands, result boundary metadata, status propagation, and rejection of human-approval status as an automatic software result.

The load_case_algebra crate provides code-neutral load case algebra combining explicit mechanics quantities and result states; it does not encode design-code load combinations, protected standards content, proprietary project data, rule-pack expression evaluation, or professional approval.
AnalysisStatus enumerates analysis states: ModelIncomplete, MechanicsSolved, RuleInputsIncomplete, UserRuleChecked, UserRuleFailed, HumanReviewRequired, and HumanApprovedForProject.
AlgebraOperation enumerates the supported load-case algebra operations: LinearCombination, ResultStateSubtraction, and RangeEnvelope.
RangeMode enumerates range-envelope selection modes: Min, Max, MinAbs, and MaxAbs.
RangeMode::token returns the canonical document token for each mode (min, max, min_abs, max_abs); document carriers must use exactly these tokens.
RangeMode::parse_token parses a canonical document token, returning None for unknown tokens so callers emit a named diagnostic rather than guessing a mode.
AlgebraQuantity is a value paired with a LoadDimension; its constructor validates that the value is finite.
AlgebraQuantity::to_boundary_record converts the quantity into a BoundaryQuantityRecord from its load dimension with a record reference, unit metadata, and provenance reference.
AlgebraQuantity::scaled multiplies the quantity value by a factor while preserving its dimension.
AlgebraOperand binds an operand_id, state_id, an AlgebraQuantity, and a vector of AnalysisStatus values.
CombinationTerm pairs an operand_id with a finite factor; its constructor validates the factor is finite.
AlgebraExpression enumerates expression shapes: LinearCombination (terms), ResultStateSubtraction (minuend_id, subtrahend_id), and RangeEnvelope (operand_ids, mode).

FindingCode enumerates algebra finding codes: MissingOperand, EmptyExpression, NonFiniteFactor, DimensionMismatch, DuplicateOperand, UnsupportedExpressionShape, MissingResultState, and StatusBoundaryViolation.
AlgebraFinding records a finding code, subject_id, and message describing an algebra boundary violation.
AlgebraResult carries the operation, an optional resulting quantity, statuses, source operand ids, and findings.
AlgebraResult::is_blocked returns true when the result has any findings.

AlgebraResult::to_result_boundary_record requires a result schema binding, validates record and unit, validates a non-empty provenance_ref, and emits a BoundaryQuantityRecord only when a quantity exists.
require_result_schema_binding accepts only ModelResultValue or ResultsQuantityResult bindings, rejecting ModelLoadCase and ModelLoadRecord with a SchemaBindingMismatch error.
AlgebraError has one variant, NonFiniteInput, carrying the offending field name and value.
evaluate_expression builds an operand map, detects duplicate operand identifiers as DuplicateOperand findings, dispatches on the expression shape, and clears the quantity when input findings exist.
evaluate_linear_combination requires at least one term, rejects non-finite factors and duplicate operands, reports missing operands, enforces compatible dimensions, and sums scaled operand values.
evaluate_result_state_subtraction requires two distinct result states, reports missing result states and dimension mismatches, and subtracts subtrahend from minuend when dimensions match.

evaluate_range_envelope requires at least one operand, sorts operand ids deterministically, rejects duplicates and missing operands, enforces compatible dimensions, and selects the extreme value per RangeMode.
prefer_current decides whether the current envelope candidate beats a new one per RangeMode (Min, Max, MinAbs, MaxAbs), breaking ties deterministically by operand id ordering.
same_dimension_or_record enforces that all algebra operands share a compatible LoadDimension, recording a DimensionMismatch finding otherwise.
collect_statuses requires explicit analysis status metadata on each operand and records a StatusBoundaryViolation when status metadata is empty.
collect_statuses rejects any status not permitted for automatic emission (e.g. human approval or compliance status) with a StatusBoundaryViolation.
Operands carrying ModelIncomplete status cannot produce an algebra output and yield a StatusBoundaryViolation finding.
finalize_result always appends HumanReviewRequired to statuses, sorts/dedups statuses, and suppresses the quantity when any findings exist.
status_rank assigns a deterministic ordering rank to each AnalysisStatus for stable status sorting.
automatic_status_allowed permits ModelIncomplete, MechanicsSolved, RuleInputsIncomplete, UserRuleChecked, UserRuleFailed, and HumanReviewRequired, but not HumanApprovedForProject.
validate_boundary_text rejects empty or 'TBD' boundary text with a MissingField error.

load_case_algebra unit tests cover linear combination sums, result-envelope unit metadata export, schema-binding rejection, dimension mismatch, subtraction, range-envelope selection and tie ordering, status propagation, and human-approval blocking.
Notes: Test module summarized as a single coverage atom.

UnitStatement: The open_pipe_stress_primitive_loads crate (version 0.1.0, edition 2021) is described as code-neutral primitive load case mechanics for OpenPipeStress and is not published.
primitive_loads depends on open_pipe_stress_frame_kernel and open_pipe_stress_linear_supports via local solver paths.

The primitive_loads crate is the bounded implementation slice for DEL-05-01, defining code-neutral primitive load records and preparing deterministic mechanics contributions for the current frame/support boundary.
primitive_loads scope covers weight, pressure, thermal, imposed displacement, hydrotest, wind, seismic, and occasional primitive load categories.
primitive_loads provides stable category and load-dimension metadata helpers for boundary records, load-case mapping, diagnostics, and tests.
Storage-neutral primitive load-case records bind one primitive category to canonical model LoadCase metadata, provenance, payload, and hash references.

Boundary quantity records carry canonical schema binding, explicit unit metadata, provenance reference, JCS payload reference, and payload-hash reference; TBD dimensions are rejected for concrete quantity metadata and unit conversion constants remain outside the crate.

primitive_loads emits deterministic findings for missing target references, invalid numeric input, missing load or source identifiers, invalid dimensions, and unsupported target/category combinations.

Storage-neutral diagnostic records map primitive-load validation and load-case assembly findings to code, class, severity, source, affected object, message, remediation, and provenance-reference fields for result-envelope transport.
primitive_loads prepares nodal force, element uniform load, and imposed-displacement contributions for later load-case algebra, stress recovery, GUI, and headless execution work.
Lumped equivalent nodal conversion is provided for explicit uniform ForcePerLength element loads when callers supply element span and node connectivity.
Equivalent-static mechanics preparation is provided for wind, seismic, and occasional loads only when callers supply an explicit basis/provenance reference.

primitive_loads does not provide protected code load combinations, design-code load categories, wind/seismic procedures, pressure stress formulas, material or section defaults, catalog data, rule-pack checks, result envelopes, or professional/code-compliance claims; inputs are explicit mechanics quantities already governed upstream.
Boundary records bind to model.schema LoadCase, LoadRecord, Result/values, or results.schema QuantityResult by explicit enum.

Unit metadata uses the accepted PKG-02 dimension vocabulary and rejects retired aliases such as temperature_difference, area_moment, and generic stiffness; the crate supplies no unit conversion constants.
Primitive load-case records enforce one primitive category per record; mixed case algebra remains downstream DEL-05-02 scope.
Diagnostic records preserve the local finding code and use local primitive-load classes; they do not introduce a shared diagnostic enum or final result envelope/API behavior.

Lumped equivalent nodal conversion is limited to translational/global ForcePerLength element loads; pressure, thermal, rotational, acceleration, dynamic-style inputs, and invalid spans/connectivity are reported as findings or construction errors rather than inferred.
ForcePerLength boundary metadata maps to the PKG-02 canonical force_per_length dimension.

Equivalent-static preparation is limited to wind, seismic, and occasional categories as explicit mechanics inputs; it validates the caller-supplied basis/provenance reference and reuses the primitive mechanics validation path without generating dynamic procedures, response parameters, code factors, environmental defaults, or conversion constants.

Solver load-vector assembly sorts accepted contributions by node, global DOF, and source ID, sums repeated node/DOF values deterministically, and returns no partial vector when any contribution has a missing source ID, invalid node/DOF, node/DOF mismatch, non-finite value, or non-finite assembled sum.

primitive_loads unit tests cover every primitive category, invalid/missing data findings, diagnostic-record mapping, deterministic application behavior, boundary metadata validation, retired dimension alias rejection, equivalent-static input boundaries, lumped equivalent nodal conversion, deterministic solver load-vector assembly, and preservation of frame/support DOF assumptions.

The primitive_loads library prepares explicit primitive loads for solver-boundary consumers and does not encode design-code load combinations, protected standards content, proprietary project data, rule-pack checks, or professional approval.
PrimitiveLoadCategory enumerates Weight, Pressure, Thermal, ImposedDisplacement, Hydrotest, Wind, Seismic, and Occasional categories.
PrimitiveLoadCategory::ALL lists all eight primitive categories, and as_str maps each to its stable string token.
PrimitiveLoadCategory::is_equivalent_static returns true only for Wind, Seismic, and Occasional categories.
LoadTarget enumerates Node(index), Element(index), and Support{node_index, dof} targets.
LoadDimension enumerates Force, Moment, ForcePerLength, Pressure, TemperatureChange, Acceleration, Displacement, and Rotation, each with a stable string token.
LoadDimension::canonical_dimension maps each load dimension onto a CanonicalDimension.

CanonicalDimension is the PKG-02 canonical dimension vocabulary including dimensionless, length, mass, time, temperature, temperature_interval, force, moment, pressure, stress, stiffness variants, and a TBD sentinel.

CanonicalDimension::from_schema_value parses canonical dimension strings and rejects retired aliases temperature_difference, area_moment, and stiffness with RetiredDimensionAlias errors, and unknown values with UnknownCanonicalDimension.
CanonicalDimension::from_load_dimension maps a LoadDimension to its CanonicalDimension, mapping TemperatureChange to TemperatureInterval.

BoundaryMetadataError enumerates boundary errors: MissingField, EmptyCollection, NonFiniteValue, DuplicateLoadId, LoadCategoryMismatch, UnknownCanonicalDimension, RetiredDimensionAlias, DimensionMismatch, and SchemaBindingMismatch.
QuantityUnitMetadata binds a unit string, a CanonicalDimension, and a unit_system_ref; validation rejects empty refs and a TBD dimension.
QuantityUnitMetadata::from_schema_values constructs metadata from a unit, a schema dimension string, and a unit-system reference.
CanonicalSchemaBinding enumerates ModelLoadCase, ModelLoadRecord, ModelResultValue, and ResultsQuantityResult, each mapping to a schema_ref pointer.
BoundaryCanonicalization currently has a single JsonJcs variant whose string token is 'JCS'.
BoundaryRecordRef binds record_id, schema_binding, target_ref, basis_ref, payload_ref, payload_hash_ref, and canonicalization; its constructor validates all reference fields are present.
BoundaryQuantityRecord binds a BoundaryRecordRef, a finite value, QuantityUnitMetadata, and a provenance_ref.
PrimitiveLoadCaseKind enumerates the eight load-case kinds and maps each to a schema_load_type, mapping Thermal to 'temperature' and Occasional to 'user_occasional'.
PrimitiveLoadCaseKind converts to and from PrimitiveLoadCategory, and PrimitiveLoadCategory::load_case_kind returns the corresponding kind.
PrimitiveLoadCaseRecord binds a record, name, load_type, a vector of PrimitiveLoad, and a provenance_ref.
PrimitiveLoadCaseRecord::new requires a ModelLoadCase schema binding, sorts loads by id, rejects empty loads, duplicate load ids, and category mismatches against the load_type's expected category.
PrimitiveLoadCaseRecord exposes schema_load_type, load_ids, canonical_field_pairs, and a deterministic round_trip_key derived from sorted canonical key/value pairs.
BoundaryQuantityRecord::new validates the value is finite, validates record and unit, and requires a non-empty provenance_ref.
BoundaryQuantityRecord::from_load_dimension and from_canonical_dimension reject a unit whose dimension does not equal the expected canonical dimension with a DimensionMismatch error.
BoundaryQuantityRecord exposes canonical_field_pairs and a deterministic round_trip_key including dimension, unit, unit_system_ref, and value.
validate_boundary_ref rejects missing references and boundary_ref_is_missing treats empty/whitespace or 'TBD' values as missing.
primitive_load_affected_object and solver_contribution_affected_object build stable affected-object identifiers, emitting explicit missing-id placeholders when the id is missing.
require_schema_binding returns a SchemaBindingMismatch error when the actual canonical schema binding differs from the expected one.
diagnostic_class_for_load_finding maps each primitive-load FindingCode to a LoadDiagnosticClass (input, topology, numeric, or unsupported-boundary blocking).
diagnostic_class_for_load_case_assembly_finding maps assembly finding codes to LoadAssemblyBlocking or LoadNumericBlocking classes.
remediation_for_load_finding supplies a fixed remediation string for each primitive-load FindingCode.
remediation_for_load_case_assembly_finding supplies a fixed remediation string for each load-case assembly finding code.
LoadQuantity pairs a finite value with a LoadDimension, with new() validating finiteness and positive() validating positive finiteness.
LoadDirection enumerates Dof(FrameDof), GlobalX, GlobalY, and GlobalZ, exposing dof_index and is_rotational.
PrimitiveLoad binds load_id, category, an optional target, a direction, and an optional magnitude.
PrimitiveLoad provides constructors nodal_force, uniform_element_load, imposed_displacement, and missing_target.
EquivalentStaticMechanicsBasis binds a basis_ref and provenance_ref, validated as present, with canonical_field_pairs and round_trip_key.
NodalLoadContribution binds load_id, node_index, global_dof, and value.
ElementUniformLoadContribution binds load_id, element_index, direction, and magnitude.
ElementLoadSpan binds element_index, node_i, node_j, and span; its constructor validates a positive finite span.
ElementAxialEffectProperties carries element_index plus optional elastic_modulus, area, thermal_expansion_coefficient, and internal_area.
PrimitiveAxialEffectContribution binds load_id, element_index, and axial_force; PrimitiveAxialEffectApplication carries axial_effects and findings with is_blocked.
ImposedDisplacementContribution binds load_id, a NodeDof, and a LoadQuantity value.

FindingCode enumerates primitive-load finding codes including MissingLoadId, MissingLoadTarget, MissingLoadMagnitude, NodeOutOfRange, ElementOutOfRange, InvalidLoadDimension, InvalidLoadDirection, span/connectivity/property codes, NonFiniteLoadMagnitude, NonFiniteAxialEffect, and UnsupportedTargetForCategory.
LoadFinding records a FindingCode, load_id, and message.
LoadDiagnosticSeverity has a single Blocking variant.
LoadDiagnosticSource enumerates PrimitiveLoadValidation and LoadCaseAssembly.
LoadDiagnosticClass enumerates LoadInputBlocking, LoadTopologyBlocking, LoadNumericBlocking, LoadUnsupportedBoundary, and LoadAssemblyBlocking with stable string tokens.
LoadDiagnosticRecord binds code, class, severity, source, affected_object, message, remediation, and provenance_ref, validating presence of required string fields.
LoadDiagnosticRecord exposes canonical_field_pairs and a deterministic round_trip_key.
LoadFinding::diagnostic_record builds a LoadDiagnosticRecord from the finding using the mapped class, PrimitiveLoadValidation source, affected object, message, and mapped remediation.
diagnostic_records_from_load_findings validates the provenance ref and converts a slice of LoadFinding into LoadDiagnosticRecord values.
LoadApplication carries nodal_loads, element_uniform_loads, imposed_displacements, and findings, with is_blocked and a global_load_vector accumulator.
SolverNodalLoadContribution binds source_id, node_index, global_dof, and value, constructible directly or from a NodalLoadContribution.
LoadCaseAssemblyFindingCode enumerates MissingSourceId, NodeOutOfRange, DofOutOfRange, NonFiniteContribution, and NodeDofMismatch.
LoadCaseAssemblyFinding records a code, source_id, and message and can build a LoadDiagnosticRecord with the LoadCaseAssembly source.
diagnostic_records_from_load_case_assembly_findings validates the provenance ref and converts assembly findings into diagnostic records.
LoadCaseAssembly carries the global_load_vector, sorted_contributions, and findings with is_blocked.

assemble_solver_load_vector sorts contributions by node/dof/source, rejects missing source id, out-of-range node or dof, node/dof mismatch, and non-finite values or sums, and returns empty vector and contributions when any finding exists.
PrimitiveLoadError enumerates NonFiniteInput and NonPositiveInput variants for invalid numeric inputs.
prepare_loads validates each load's id, target, and magnitude, dispatches to node, element, or support preparation, and deterministically sorts nodal, element, and imposed-displacement contributions.
prepare_equivalent_static_loads validates the basis, accepts only equivalent-static categories (reporting UnsupportedTargetForCategory otherwise), and reuses prepare_loads for the scoped loads.

prepare_lumped_nodal_loads converts uniform ForcePerLength element loads to half-span nodal contributions at each end node, requiring valid element target, supported category, ForcePerLength dimension, translational direction, and a unique valid span.

prepare_straight_pipe_axial_effects computes thermal axial force (E*A*alpha*deltaT) and pressure thrust (pressure*internal_area) for element loads, requiring matching dimensions and positive/finite physical properties, and rejecting other categories.
prepare_node_load validates node range, nodal category eligibility, and nodal dimension before pushing a NodalLoadContribution.
prepare_element_load validates element range, element category eligibility, translational direction, and element dimension before pushing an ElementUniformLoadContribution.
prepare_support_load validates node range, restricts support targets to ImposedDisplacement, and validates imposed dimension before pushing an ImposedDisplacementContribution.
category_allows_node_target permits only Wind, Seismic, and Occasional categories for nodal targets.
category_allows_element_target permits Weight, Pressure, Thermal, Hydrotest, Wind, Seismic, and Occasional categories for element targets.
category_allows_lumped_nodal_conversion permits Weight, Hydrotest, Wind, Seismic, and Occasional categories for lumped nodal conversion.
valid_nodal_dimension requires Moment for rotational directions and Force for translational directions.
valid_element_dimension requires ForcePerLength for weight/wind/seismic/occasional, Pressure or ForcePerLength for pressure/hydrotest, TemperatureChange for thermal, and rejects imposed displacement.
valid_imposed_dimension requires Displacement for translational DOF and Rotation for rotational DOF.
valid_lumped_nodal_direction accepts translational DOF directions and the global X/Y/Z directions.
find_element_span returns the unique span record for an element, reporting MissingElementSpan when absent and InvalidElementSpan when duplicated.
valid_element_span validates the span is finite and positive, both endpoint node indices are in range, and the element does not connect a node to itself.
finite_load_magnitude rejects non-finite load magnitudes with a NonFiniteLoadMagnitude finding.
find_axial_effect_properties returns the unique axial-effect property record for an element, reporting MissingElementProperties when absent and InvalidElementProperties when duplicated.
finite_physical_property requires a present finite property value, reporting MissingPhysicalProperty or InvalidPhysicalProperty otherwise.
positive_physical_property additionally requires the property value to be strictly positive.
push_axial_effect_if_finite records a PrimitiveAxialEffectContribution only when the computed axial force is finite, otherwise reporting NonFiniteAxialEffect.
sort_nodal_loads deterministically orders nodal contributions by node index, global DOF, then load id.
validate_finite and validate_positive_finite enforce finite and positive-finite numeric inputs respectively for primitive loads.

primitive_loads unit tests cover category and dimension metadata stability, retired alias rejection, and the full preparation, assembly, and axial-effect behavior described in the README verification.
Notes: Test module summarized as a single coverage atom.

UnitStatement: The open_pipe_stress_stress_recovery crate (version 0.1.0, edition 2021) is described as code-neutral mechanics stress recovery for OpenPipeStress and is not published.
stress_recovery depends on open_pipe_stress_primitive_loads and open_pipe_stress_straight_pipe via local paths.

The stress_recovery crate is the bounded implementation slice for DEL-05-03; it recovers code-neutral mechanics stresses from explicit element force resultants, section properties, and optional pressure basis inputs.
stress_recovery computes axial normal stress from supplied axial force and area.
stress_recovery computes bending normal stress components from supplied bending moments and section moduli.
stress_recovery computes torsional shear stress from supplied torque, torsion radius, and torsion constant.
stress_recovery computes thin-wall pressure membrane components from explicit pressure, radius, and wall thickness inputs.
stress_recovery computes mechanics-only component stress ranges from two recovered stress states.
stress_recovery constructs force resultants from solver element-end resultants with finite-input validation and no code stress interpretation.
stress_recovery validates input unit metadata for force resultants, section properties, and pressure-basis quantities using the accepted PKG-02 canonical dimension vocabulary.
stress_recovery produces recovered stress boundary records binding explicit stress-unit metadata to the canonical result/result-envelope schema surface with payload and payload-hash references.

stress_recovery emits deterministic findings for missing inputs, non-finite values, non-positive properties, missing or incompatible unit metadata, non-finite recovered outputs, incomplete range states, incomplete status, and status-boundary violations.

stress_recovery does not implement design-code stress equations, allowables, stress indices, SIF/flexibility tables, rule-pack checks, protected standards content, pipe tables, unit conversion constants, report rendering, GUI behavior, local FEA handoff, or professional/code-compliance claims.

stress_recovery inputs are already-parsed mechanics quantities from governed solver, section, load, unit, and status boundaries; conversion, result-envelope, persistence, tolerance, rule-check, and benchmark-publication details remain TBD.

recover_stresses_with_unit_metadata requires unit and unit-system references for every present stress input quantity before recovery, and rejects force-per-length metadata as a stress force resultant (force or moment dimensions required).

Recovered component records can bind to the canonical model result value or schema-first result-envelope quantity surface; the crate records payload and hash references for deterministic handoff but does not compute hashes, choose conversion constants, set production tolerances, or make compliance claims.

stress_recovery unit tests cover axial, bending, torsion, and pressure membrane components, combined normal/shear summaries, mechanics-only stress ranges, element-end resultant input construction, missing/invalid inputs, unit metadata validation including force-per-length rejection, result boundary records, non-finite recovered values, and analysis-status propagation without human approval or code-compliance claims.

Crate stress_recovery recovers open mechanics stress components from explicit resultants and section properties; it does not encode design-code stress equations, allowables, stress indices, SIF/flexibility tables, protected standards content, or professional approval.
AnalysisStatus enum enumerates analysis states: ModelIncomplete, MechanicsSolved, RuleInputsIncomplete, UserRuleChecked, UserRuleFailed, HumanReviewRequired, HumanApprovedForProject.

FindingCode enum enumerates stress-recovery finding codes including MissingResultant, MissingSectionProperty, MissingPressureInput, NonFiniteInput, NonPositiveInput, StatusBoundaryViolation, BlockedStressState, MissingUnitMetadata, and InvalidUnitMetadata.
StressFinding struct carries a FindingCode, a subject_id, and a human-readable message.
ForceResultants struct holds optional axial_force, bending_moment_y, bending_moment_z, and torsional_moment.
ForceResultants::from_element_end_resultants validates each force/moment via checked_finite before constructing the resultants.
ForceResultants::from_station_resultants validates station fraction and finite station distances/shears before deriving element-end resultants from StationResultants.
StressSectionProperties struct holds optional area, section_modulus_y, section_modulus_z, torsion_constant, and torsion_radius.
PressureBasis struct holds optional pressure, membrane_radius, and wall_thickness.
StressComponents struct holds optional axial_normal, bending_normal_y, bending_normal_z, torsional_shear, pressure_hoop, and pressure_longitudinal stress components.
StressComponents::to_result_boundary_record requires a result schema binding and emits a BoundaryQuantityRecord with CanonicalDimension::Stress for the selected component.
StressComponentKind enum identifies which stress component to read: AxialNormal, BendingNormalY, BendingNormalZ, TorsionalShear, PressureHoop, PressureLongitudinal.
StressSummary struct reports max_normal, min_normal, and max_shear_magnitude.
StressRangeComponents struct holds optional per-component stress ranges (axial, bending y/z, torsional shear, pressure hoop, pressure longitudinal).
StressRecoveryInput struct bundles ForceResultants, StressSectionProperties, optional PressureBasis, and a vector of AnalysisStatus.
StressRecoveryResult::is_blocked returns true when any findings are present.
StationStressRecoveryResult struct pairs a station_id and station_fraction with a StressRecoveryResult.
StressRecoveryError enum variants: NonFiniteInput, NonPositiveInput, and InvalidStationFraction.
Station fraction must satisfy 0 <= value <= 1, else StressRecoveryError::InvalidStationFraction is raised.

recover_stresses computes axial_normal=axial_force/area, bending_normal=moment/section_modulus, torsional_shear, and optional pressure membrane components, returning blocked empty components if findings exist.
recover_station_stresses wraps recover_stresses for a single station, carrying station_id and station_fraction.
recover_station_stress_sweep maps a slice of StationResultants to per-station stress recovery results with generated station ids.
recover_stresses_with_unit_metadata validates input unit metadata at the boundary before performing recovery; if metadata findings exist it returns blocked empty components.

validate_stress_input_unit_metadata checks unit metadata for each resultant, section property, and pressure input against its expected CanonicalDimension (Force, Moment, Area, SectionModulus, SecondMomentArea, Length, Pressure).
recover_stress_range requires both first and second mechanics states unblocked, then computes per-component absolute stress ranges.
checked_positive returns NonPositiveInput error when value <= 0.0 after a finite check.
checked_finite returns NonFiniteInput error when value is not finite.
check_unit_metadata emits MissingUnitMetadata when metadata is absent or invalid and InvalidUnitMetadata when the metadata dimension differs from the expected canonical dimension.
require_result_schema_binding accepts ModelResultValue or ResultsQuantityResult bindings and rejects ModelLoadCase/ModelLoadRecord with SchemaBindingMismatch.
divide_optional requires a finite numerator and a positive denominator, then returns the checked recovered quotient.
torsional_shear is recovered as torque * torsion_radius / torsion_constant, requiring finite torque and positive radius and torsion constant.
pressure_membrane computes hoop stress = pressure * membrane_radius / wall_thickness and longitudinal stress = hoop / 2, requiring finite pressure and positive radius and wall thickness.
checked_recovered emits NonFiniteInput finding when a recovered value is non-finite.
range_optional returns the absolute difference of two states or emits MissingResultant when exactly one state value is present.
summarize_components computes max/min normal stress as (axial + pressure_longitudinal) +/- (|bending_y| + |bending_z|) and max shear magnitude as |torsional_shear|.
collect_statuses requires explicit mechanics status, requires a MechanicsSolved input, rejects human-approval/compliance statuses, and always appends HumanReviewRequired.
automatic_status_allowed permits all AnalysisStatus values except HumanApprovedForProject for automatic emission.
stress_recovery module includes a #[cfg(test)] test suite exercising recovery, unit-metadata gating, range, and boundary-record behavior.
Crate open_pipe_stress_user_loads (v0.1.0, edition 2021) provides code-neutral concentrated and distributed user load application; publish=false.
user_loads depends on open_pipe_stress_frame_kernel, open_pipe_stress_primitive_loads, and open_pipe_stress_straight_pipe.
The user_loads crate is the bounded implementation slice for DEL-05-05, preparing explicit concentrated forces, concentrated moments, and distributed user loads for the frame-solver boundary.

Scope: concentrated force on node translational DOF, concentrated moment on node rotational DOF, and uniform distributed user loads on element translational directions over an explicit normalized span.
User-load boundary records require explicit unit metadata, provenance reference, canonical schema binding, JCS payload reference, and payload-hash reference.
User_loads emits deterministic findings for missing targets, invalid dimensions, unsupported target/load combinations, non-finite inputs, invalid spans, and non-positive element lengths.

Boundary: the user_loads crate does not provide design-code load combinations, public default factors, wind/seismic procedures, material/section defaults, protected standards content, rule-pack checks, or professional/code-compliance claims.

User-load input and contribution records bind to canonical schemas/model.schema.yaml#/$defs/LoadRecord; recovery hooks bind to model result values or schemas/results.schema.yaml#/$defs/QuantityResult.
Distributed ForcePerLength quantities carry the PKG-02 canonical force_per_length dimension; the crate stores payload/hash references but does not compute hashes or invent unit metadata.

Verification: unit tests cover concentrated force/moment, uniform distributed load, invalid/missing input findings, dimension checks, deterministic contribution ordering, unit-bearing boundary records, recovery-hook schema binding, and the no-default/no-compliance boundary.

Crate user_loads prepares explicit user loads for solver-boundary consumers and does not encode design-code load combinations, public default factors, protected standards content, rule-pack checks, or professional approval.
UserLoadKind enum: ConcentratedForce, ConcentratedMoment, UniformDistributedLoad.
UserLoadDirection enum: GlobalX/Y/Z (translational) and RotationX/Y/Z (rotational).
UserLoadDirection::dof_index maps each direction to a frame-kernel DOF index (UX/UY/UZ/RX/RY/RZ); is_rotational identifies rotational directions.
UserLoadQuantity holds a finite value and a LoadDimension; construction validates the value is finite.
UserLoadQuantity::to_model_load_boundary_record requires a ModelLoadRecord schema binding and emits a BoundaryQuantityRecord from the load dimension.
UserLoadTarget enum: Node(index), Element{element_index,span,element_length}, ElementStation{element_index,station_fraction}.
ElementLoadSpan holds start_fraction and end_fraction; full() spans 0.0..1.0 and length_fraction returns end-start.
UserLoad struct holds load_id, kind, optional target, direction, optional quantity, and optional provenance_ref.
UserLoad::concentrated_force constructs a ConcentratedForce targeting a node translational DOF.
UserLoad::concentrated_moment constructs a ConcentratedMoment targeting a node rotational DOF.
UserLoad::uniform_distributed constructs a UniformDistributedLoad over an element span with optional element length.
UserLoad::element_concentrated_force constructs a ConcentratedForce targeting an element station fraction.
UserLoad::missing_target constructs a load with no target for negative-path testing.
ContributionTrace records load_id, kind, and optional provenance_ref propagated from a UserLoad.
NodalLoadContribution holds node_index, global_dof, value, dimension, and a ContributionTrace.
NodalLoadContribution::to_model_load_boundary_record requires ModelLoadRecord binding and falls back to load_id when provenance_ref is absent.
ElementDistributedLoadContribution holds element_index, direction, magnitude, span, optional equivalent_total, and a ContributionTrace.
RecoveryHookKind enum: NodalForce, NodalMoment, ElementDistributedLoad, ElementAxialEffect.
ResultRecoveryHook holds load_id, hook_kind, target_ref, dimension, and optional provenance_ref.
ResultRecoveryHook::to_result_boundary_record accepts ModelResultValue/ResultsQuantityResult bindings and rejects ModelLoadRecord and ModelLoadCase with SchemaBindingMismatch.

User-load FindingCode enum: MissingLoadTarget, MissingLoadQuantity, NodeOutOfRange, ElementOutOfRange, InvalidLoadDimension, InvalidLoadDirection, UnsupportedTargetForLoadKind, InvalidDistributionSpan, NonPositiveElementLength, MissingElementGeometry, NonFiniteAxialEffect.
UserLoadFinding carries a FindingCode, load_id, and message.
UserLoadApplication holds nodal_loads, element_distributed_loads, recovery_hooks, and findings.
UserLoadApplication::is_blocked returns true if any findings; global_load_vector assembles a node_count*DOF_PER_NODE vector summing nodal contributions.
UserLoadError enum has a single NonFiniteInput variant.

apply_user_loads dispatches each load to nodal, element-distributed, or element-station preparation by target, requiring explicit target and quantity, and returns deterministically sorted contributions.
apply_user_loads sorts nodal loads by (node_index, global_dof, load_id), distributed loads by (element_index, direction dof, load_id), and recovery hooks by (target_ref, load_id).
apply_straight_pipe_equivalent_user_loads derives node_count from pipe end nodes and converts element targets into straight-pipe equivalent nodal loads, point forces, or distributed loads.
apply_straight_pipe_equivalent_user_loads_with_axial_effects additionally folds primitive axial-effect contributions into equivalent nodal loads and re-sorts.

prepare_straight_pipe_axial_effect_load validates the contribution element matches the pipe, builds a StraightPipeAxialEffect, and pushes equivalent nodal loads plus an ElementAxialEffect recovery hook.

prepare_straight_pipe_distributed_load requires UniformDistributedLoad kind, translational direction, ForcePerLength dimension, valid span, and a supplied element length matching pipe geometry within 1e-9.
Straight-pipe distributed equivalent_total = quantity.value * pipe.length() * span.length_fraction().
prepare_straight_pipe_point_force requires ConcentratedForce kind, translational direction, and Force dimension, then converts a station fraction into equivalent nodal loads with a NodalForce hook.
push_equivalent_nodal_loads distributes an element-DOF equivalent load vector onto node_i/node_j contributions, assigning Force dimension for translational DOF and Moment for rotational DOF.
global_vector_for_direction returns a 3-vector only for translational directions and None for rotational directions.
prepare_nodal_user_load validates node index bounds and kind/dimension, then pushes a nodal contribution and a recovery hook keyed node:index:dof:global_dof.

prepare_element_station_user_load_without_geometry validates element bounds, ConcentratedForce kind, station fraction in [0,1], translational direction, and Force dimension, then emits MissingElementGeometry requiring straight-pipe recovery.
prepare_element_user_load validates element bounds, UniformDistributedLoad kind, translational direction, ForcePerLength dimension, span 0<=start<end<=1, and positive finite element length.
validate_nodal_kind_and_dimension requires ConcentratedForce->translational+Force, ConcentratedMoment->rotational+Moment, and rejects UniformDistributedLoad on a node target.
require_schema_binding returns SchemaBindingMismatch when the actual canonical schema binding differs from the expected binding.
agent_rationale package exposes AGENT_RATIONALE_VERSION, canonical_json, and record_agent_rationale for agent rationale records and professional-boundary guards.
agent_rationale engine (DEL-16-04) binds agent reasoning metadata to operation/audit context without accepting engineering work, applying operations, or mutating accepted model state.
AGENT_RATIONALE_VERSION is "0.1.0".

PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY for agent rationale asserts human_review_required and agent_output_is_decision_support_only true, and all compliance/certification/sealing/approval/authentication/external-validation/accept-work/mutate-state claims false.
PROHIBITED_CLAIM_PATTERNS define regex guards for authority language: compliance, certification, sealing, authentication, professional approval, external validation, and autonomous acceptance.

record_agent_rationale creates a deterministic rationale record for operation review metadata, consuming a DEL-16-01 operation envelope plus optional audit/validation/source/actor/assumptions context.

A rationale record's status is blocked_by_professional_boundary when any blocking diagnostic exists, else captured_for_user_review; it never creates an accepted operation record, mutates accepted model state, or bypasses user acceptance.
rationale_record_id is 'rationale:' + a 24-char truncated sha256 over the canonical rationale payload; rationale_record_hash hashes the full record.
canonical_json serializes rationale output with sorted keys, compact separators, and ensure_ascii (stable ordering).
_input_diagnostics emits a blocking diagnostic when the operation envelope is missing or not bound to deliverable DEL-16-01, and TBD warnings for missing audit/validation/source/actor/text/timestamp.
_claim_diagnostics scans concatenated text against PROHIBITED_CLAIM_PATTERNS and emits a blocking PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY diagnostic per matched authority claim.
An assumption is unresolved when its status is one of tbd, unresolved, pending, or unknown.
_hash_payload computes sha256 hexdigest over canonical JSON of a value.
audit_trail package exposes AUDIT_TRAIL_VERSION, canonical_json, and record_operation_audit_trail for the user-acceptance audit trail over structured model operations.

audit_trail engine (DEL-16-03) records user acceptance or rejection decisions over structured model operations, validation outcomes, and diff-preview references; it does not apply operations to model state.
AUDIT_TRAIL_VERSION is "0.1.0".
audit_trail PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY asserts human_review_required true and all compliance/certification/sealing/approval/authentication claims false.
record_operation_audit_trail creates deterministic audit records per operation without mutating accepted state, returning a trail with decision counts, records, diagnostics, and an audit_trail_hash.
audit_posture asserts default_user_acceptance_required true, accepted records require explicit user signal, and rejected records do not mutate accepted state.
_record_for_operation derives status accepted only when there is an explicit user acceptance signal and no blocking diagnostics; otherwise rejected or held_for_user_acceptance.
An operation is accepted only when it is an explicit accept candidate and no record diagnostic has blocking severity.
_record_diagnostics emits a blocking AUDIT-EXPLICIT-USER-ACCEPTANCE-REQUIRED when neither accepted nor rejected, and adds acceptance-gate diagnostics for accept candidates.
_acceptance_gate_diagnostics requires passed schema/constraint/unit validation, generated diff preview, and not_applied application status before an accepted record.
Accepted operation records require a hash-bound diff-preview reference (AUDIT-DIFF-PREVIEW-HASH-MISSING blocking otherwise).
Accepted operation records require a current accepted model-state hash (AUDIT-MODEL-STATE-HASH-MISSING blocking otherwise).
Accepted records require an operation precondition model_state_record current hash that matches the accepted model-state hash, else AUDIT-OPERATION-CURRENT-HASH-MISSING/MISMATCH blocking.
_explicit_user_acceptance is true only when the signal has accepted=true, decision 'accept', and actor_type 'user'.
_decision_counts tallies records into accepted, rejected, and held_for_user_acceptance counts.
audit_record_id is 'audit:' + a 24-char truncated sha256 over the operation, validation outcome, diff-preview ref, acceptance signal, timestamp, rationale, and audit metadata.
_state_hash resolves a model-state hash from state_hash, model_state_hash, or hash on the model-state or nested model_state mapping.
Crate open_pipe_stress_operation_applier (v0.1.0) provides structured editor-operation validation, diff preview, and an apply seam for OpenPipeStress model documents; publish=false.
operation_applier builds as crate-type cdylib+rlib; cdylib supports a feature-gated wasm32 browser-engine build while rlib keeps the native library/test path.
operation_applier 'wasm' feature (DEC-020 / ADR-0001) enables wasm-bindgen JSON-string exports; native builds and tests never enable it.

operation_applier depends on open_pipe_stress_canonical_json (RFC 8785 JCS canonical JSON, the single hash-seam canonicalization), open_pipe_stress_units, serde, serde_json, sha2, and a pinned wasm-bindgen =0.2.123.
The operation_applier crate is the structured editor-operation validation, diff-preview, and apply seam for the desktop app.

operation_applier is the DEL-16-02 / DEL-16-03 runtime seam: it consumes the UI's structured EditorOperationIntent records, validates them against a model document without mutating it, and produces deterministic diff-preview rows.
Only the apply path returns a new model document with the single validated change applied plus an honest acceptance receipt.
PKG-16 boundary rule: the input model document is never mutated in place.
PKG-16 boundary rule: blocked operations are findings, not silent fallbacks — no invented values, no ungoverned unit conversion, no geometry defaults.
PKG-16 boundary rule: receipts record a user-initiated local-session acceptance basis only, never a professional, certification, sealing, approval, authentication, or code-compliance claim.
OPERATION_APPLIER_VERSION constant is '0.1.0' and is carried as the outcome schema_version.
OUTCOME_DOCUMENT_KIND constant is 'openpipestress.desktop.operation_outcome', the document_kind of every OperationOutcome.
BACKEND_CANONICALIZATION is 'rfc8785_jcs' (RFC 8785 JCS since completion-plan H5: ECMAScript number rendering, UTF-16 key sort, JSON.stringify string escaping), carried in hash evidence.
ENGINE_SOURCE constant is 'core/model_operations/operation_applier', stamped as the source on every diagnostic.
RESTRAINT_TOKENS is the restraint-direction vocabulary [UX, UY, UZ, RX, RY, RZ] used by preview model documents.
CANONICAL_DIMENSIONS is the accepted PKG-02 dimension vocabulary (30 tokens) shared by docs/SPEC.md §4, schemas/units.schema.yaml DimensionId, and the DEL-16-02 validation-preview engine.

The canonical dimension set includes dimensionless, length, mass, time, temperature, temperature_interval, angle, rotation, force, moment, pressure, stress, area, volume, density, linear_stiffness, rotational_stiffness, displacement, velocity, acceleration, thermal_conductivity, specific_heat, thermal_expansion_coefficient, second_moment_area, section_modulus, mass_per_length, volume_per_length, slope, force_per_length, and TBD.
OutcomeDiagnostic struct carries id, code, severity, message, remediation, affected_refs, and source for each finding.
DiffPreviewRow struct carries entity_ref, object_type, field_path, before, after, unit, dimension, and change_kind for a single previewed change.
ModelBasisEvidence struct carries claimed_model_hash, claimed_hash_canonicalization, backend_model_hash, backend_canonicalization, and binding_status.
ValidationStates struct carries schema_validation, reference_validation, unit_validation, before_state_validation, diff_preview_status, and application_status.
AcceptanceRecord struct carries acceptance_basis, acceptance_is_professional_approval (bool), and persistence_status.

OperationOutcome is the top-level result document with schema_version, document_kind, deliverable_refs, mode, application_route, operation_id, change_id, kinds, target, validation, diff_preview, diagnostics, model_basis, input_model_unchanged, applied_model, applied_model_backend_hash, acceptance, audit_boundary, and professional_boundary.
EnteredQuantity holds a user-entered value (f64) and its unit string.

UnitSource enum distinguishes SiblingUnitField (unit stored next to value as {value,unit}) from ProjectUnits(key) (bare numeric whose unit basis is the project unit-system entry, e.g. node positions use project.units.length).
FieldKind enum classifies editable fields as Text, Number{require_positive}, Quantity{require_positive,unit_source}, EntityRef{collection}, or RestraintSet.
FieldKind::Quantity with require_positive rejects non-physical zero/negative geometry and modulus values.
FieldRule pairs a static field_path with its FieldKind, driving per-object-type validation.
COMBINATION_BASIS_CLOSED_SET (TP-APP-R2-COMBEXPR-001) is the closed set [mechanics, result_state_subtraction, range_envelope], mirroring core/loads/load_case_algebra::AlgebraExpression vocabulary.
Combination basis 'mechanics' is a linear combination over explicit terms; 'result_state_subtraction' is minuend_id minus subtrahend_id; 'range_envelope' is a mode-selected value across operand_ids.
Code/rule and owner-basis combination types remain private/deferred (not in the closed set).
COMBINATION_RANGE_MODE_TOKENS is the closed set [min, max, min_abs, max_abs], mirroring core/loads/load_case_algebra::RangeMode.
DEFERRED_FIELDS lists inspector-offered fields whose application is deliberately deferred to a later completion-plan item, returned as explicit blocked findings so the scope limit stays visible.
Deferred fields: Component.kind editing is deferred to the component editor scope (Phase C/D), and Combination.terms editing is deferred to the load case manager (A4).
field_rules(object_type) returns the static FieldRule set for each supported object type (Material, Node, Element, Support, Component, Load, Combination); unknown types get an empty rule set.

Material editable fields are label, provenance, elastic_modulus.value (positive quantity), shear_modulus.value (positive quantity), and thermal_expansion_coefficient.value (sign-unconstrained quantity).
Node editable fields are label, provenance, and position.x/y/z, each a length quantity whose unit basis is project.units.length (sign-unconstrained).
Element editable fields are label, provenance, material (EntityRef into materials), section.outside_diameter.value, and section.wall_thickness.value (positive sibling-unit quantities).
Support editable fields are label, provenance, node (EntityRef into nodes), and restraints (RestraintSet).
Component editable fields are label, provenance, and node (EntityRef into nodes).
Load editable fields are label, status, kind, and provenance (all Text).
Combination editable fields are label, basis, and provenance (all Text).

collection_for(object_type) maps object types to model collection keys: Material->materials, Node->nodes, Element->pipe_segments, Support->supports, Component->components, Load->load_cases, Combination->combinations.
validate_operation(model, intent, claimed_model_hash) validates a structured editor-operation intent against a model document and never mutates or returns a model.
apply_operation(model, intent, claimed_model_hash) validates and, when no blocking finding exists, applies the single change to a cloned model document; the input model is never mutated in place.

The wasm_api module is the JSON-string boundary for the wasm32 browser-engine build (--features wasm; DEC-020 / ADR-0001); exports accept and return JSON strings so the JavaScript shim stays a thin transport. Native builds and tests do not compile it.

Malformed input JSON to the wasm engine returns a structured error envelope (document_kind openpipestress.desktop.wasm_engine_input_error) instead of trapping — surfaced as an explicit diagnostic, never a silent fallback.
WASM input-error code is 'WASM-ENGINE-INPUT-JSON-INVALID' with severity 'blocking'.
wasm run_json parses model, intent, and claimed_model_hash JSON; a null claimed_model_hash maps to None.
Honest receipt: outcomes produced through the in-process wasm engine set application_route to 'local_wasm_engine', not the Tauri backend command route.

canonical_json_string(value_json) canonicalizes a JSON document with the engine's RFC 8785 (JCS) form — the same function the engine uses for model hashes (H1 / F-5a hash seam; the desktop frontend has no canonicalization of its own).
canonical_sha256_hex(value_json) returns the lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the canonical form of a JSON document.
Mode enum has ValidateOnly and Apply variants selecting the run pipeline path.
Checker accumulates diagnostics and tracks schema_blocked plus reference_state, unit_state, and before_state (each starting 'not_run').
Checker.blocking() returns true when any accumulated diagnostic has severity 'blocking'.
Checker.push assigns each diagnostic a deterministic id 'diagnostic:operation-applier:{code-lowercased}:{NNN}' and stamps ENGINE_SOURCE as its source.

run(model, intent, claimed_model_hash, mode) is the core pipeline: it extracts intent fields, runs structure/audit/kind checks, computes model-basis evidence, dispatches per change_kind resolution, builds diff preview, optionally applies on a cloned model, and assembles the OperationOutcome.
run extracts operation_id, change_id, operation_kind, change_kind, object_type, target_ref, field_path, before, after, unit, and dimension from the intent (with defaults for missing).
Field-level resolution proceeds only for supported structured payloads when schema is not blocked; underspecified viewport gestures are held rather than invented.

run dispatches resolution by change_kind to dedicated resolvers (modify field, create/delete node, connect/delete pipe run, create section/material/support/load_case, create/delete primitive load, create/delete combination and combination term, delete support).
On apply with no blocking finding, run clones the model, applies the resolved change, and records applied_model_backend_hash as 'sha256:' + sha256_hex(canonical_json(next_model)).

ValidationStates: schema_validation is 'blocked' or 'passed'; diff_preview_status is 'blocked_by_validation' or 'generated'; application_status is 'not_applied' (validate-only), 'applied_to_session_model' (applied), or 'blocked'.

When applied, acceptance_basis is 'user_initiated_apply_in_local_session' with persistence_status 'session_state_only_not_yet_saved'; otherwise 'none_validation_only' / 'not_applicable_no_application'. acceptance_is_professional_approval is always false.
run sorts diagnostics deterministically by (code, message) before emitting the outcome.
OperationOutcome deliverable_refs are ['DEL-16-02','DEL-16-03'] and default application_route is 'tauri_backend_apply'; input_model_unchanged is always true.

audit_boundary records mutation_route 'structured_operations_only', direct_model_mutation_allowed false, requires_user_acceptance true, input_model_mutated_in_place false, and applied_model_is_new_document.
professional_boundary records human_review_required true and false for every software compliance, certification, sealing, approval, and authentication claim.

ResolvedField holds the FieldKind, current_display (inspector-style before value), parsed applied_value, path segments inside the entity, and additional sibling writes belonging to the same validated edit.
QuantityEdit holds a parsed value (f64) and unit for a numeric edit.

check_intent_structure blocks (schema) with OP-INTENT-FIELD-MISSING when any required intent field is absent: operation_id, operation_kind, operation_status, target.object_type, target.ref, change.change_id, change.change_kind, change.field_path, audit_boundary, professional_boundary, and change.before/after/unit/dimension.
check_audit_boundary blocks with OP-DIRECT-MUTATION-BLOCKED unless mutation_route is 'structured_operations_only' and direct_model_mutation_allowed is false.
is_modify_change_kind returns true only for change kinds set_field, update_load, and update_support.
check_kinds blocks with OP-KIND-UNSUPPORTED any change_kind outside the structured editor-operation taxonomy.

The supported change-kind taxonomy is set_field, update_load, update_support, create_node, delete_node, connect_pipe_run, delete_pipe_run, create_section, create_material, create_support, create_load_case, delete_load_case, create_primitive_load, delete_primitive_load, create_combination, delete_combination, create_combination_term, delete_support, delete_combination_term, and insert_component_symbol.
check_kinds blocks with OP-CHANGE-KIND-MISMATCH when operation_kind does not match the expected kind for the change_kind (modify/create/delete/connect/insert).

insert_component_symbol is blocked with OP-GEOMETRY-INPUT-INCOMPLETE: the viewport gesture does not yet carry explicit geometry/connectivity inputs and values are not invented on the user's behalf (completion plan A3).

resolve_create_node requires object_type 'Node' and field_path 'nodes', a 'not_present' before value, present and length-compatible project length unit metadata (DEC-018), an intent length unit, and dimension 'length'; otherwise it emits blocking findings.
resolve_create_node blocks with OP-TARGET-ALREADY-EXISTS when the target node id already exists; create operations never overwrite existing entities.

resolve_create_node requires the after payload to be a JSON object with matching id, non-empty label, non-empty provenance, and finite numeric x/y/z coordinates, converting coordinates to the stored length unit.

resolve_delete_node requires object_type 'Node', field_path 'nodes', after-value 'not_present', unit 'none', and dimension 'dimensionless'; it blocks when the node is missing or still referenced by other model entities.
resolve_connect_pipe_run resolves an explicit pipe-run connection between existing nodes, validating length-unit geometry and endpoint references.
resolve_delete_pipe_run removes one pipe run only when it is unreferenced (e.g. by primitive loads); it blocks otherwise.
resolve_create_section validates and builds a new pipe section record from an explicit payload, preserving compatible entered length units and blocking duplicate ids or invalid geometry.
resolve_create_material validates and builds a new material record, requiring positive modulus quantities and blocking duplicate ids or invalid quantity payloads.
resolve_create_support validates and builds a new support record, blocking duplicate ids and missing node references.
resolve_create_load_case creates an empty load-case shell only (no primitive loads embedded at creation).
resolve_delete_load_case removes an unreferenced load case only, blocking when combinations still reference it.

resolve_create_primitive_load validates and builds a single primitive load (concentrated/distributed force, concentrated moment, pressure, thermal, or imposed displacement) attached to a load case, preserving compatible entered units.
resolve_create_combination creates a combination record whose basis is in the closed set, dispatching to mechanics, subtraction, or range-envelope builders.
check_combination_payload_shape blocks create payloads carrying fields belonging to a different basis, so applied records always match exactly one closed-set expression shape.
check_combination_operand_load_case validates that combination operands reference existing load cases.
resolve_create_mechanics_combination builds a mechanics combination as a linear combination over explicit terms, including an initial term.
resolve_create_subtraction_combination builds a result_state_subtraction combination as minuend_id minus subtrahend_id.
resolve_create_range_combination builds a range_envelope combination as a mode-selected value across operand_ids.
resolve_create_combination_term appends exactly one term to a mechanics-basis combination and requires a mechanics-basis target.
resolve_delete_primitive_load removes one indexed primitive load only from its load case.
resolve_delete_combination removes one combination record only.
resolve_delete_combination_term removes one indexed term only from a combination.
resolve_delete_support removes one unreferenced support only, blocking when an imposed-displacement load references it.

resolve_field resolves a modify-field edit: it blocks with OP-OBJECT-TYPE-UNSUPPORTED for unknown object types, then validates the field against its FieldRule (text, number, quantity, entity ref, restraint set) and builds a ResolvedField.
check_before validates that the intent's before value matches the current model display (string staleness check), recording before_state.
check_before_numeric performs the before-value staleness check numerically rather than by string compare.
apply_resolved_field writes the parsed value (and any additional sibling writes) into the cloned model at the resolved path segments.
apply_created_node appends the validated new node to the model's nodes collection.
apply_deleted_node removes the node from the model's nodes collection by id.
apply_created_pipe appends the validated new pipe run to the model's pipe_segments collection.
apply_deleted_pipe removes the pipe run from pipe_segments by id.
apply_created_section, apply_created_material, apply_created_support, and apply_created_load_case each append the validated new record to its respective collection.
apply_deleted_load_case removes the load case from load_cases by id.
apply_created_primitive_load appends a primitive load to the named load case; apply_deleted_primitive_load removes the indexed primitive load from it.

apply_created_combination, apply_deleted_combination, apply_created_combination_term, apply_deleted_combination_term, and apply_deleted_support each perform the single validated mutation on the cloned model.
model_basis_evidence echoes the claimed model hash and backend model hash with their canonicalizations and a binding_status, without asserting cross-canonicalization equality.
is_primitive_magnitude_path recognizes field paths that address a primitive load's magnitude.
parse_quantity_edit parses a numeric value and unit into a QuantityEdit, rejecting non-finite/non-numeric input.
is_combination_term_factor_path and combination_term_index_from_field_path recognize and index combination-term factor field paths.
primitive_load_index_from_field_path extracts the primitive-load index encoded in a field path.
combination_term_display formats a combination term as its load_case and factor for display.
load_case_delete_display, combination_delete_display, primitive_load_delete_display, and primitive_load_target_display build human-readable deletion/target summaries.

combination_basis_shape_mismatch returns a blocking description when the stored combination record does not already carry exactly the fields the requested basis evaluates; None means the basis edit keeps the record honestly evaluable.
Cross-shape combination basis changes are re-authoring (delete + create), not field edits.
dimensioned_quantity and dimensioned_quantity_any_sign validate a numeric quantity against a dimension (the latter allowing negative values).
quantity_value_in_unit and length_value_in_unit convert an entered value from its intent unit to the stored unit, blocking when conversion is unavailable.
unit_symbol_matches_dimension(symbol, dimension) returns whether a unit symbol belongs to the given Dimension.
vector_value extracts an (x,y,z) f64 triple from a record key.
normalize_restraint_tokens parses and validates comma-separated restraint tokens against the RESTRAINT_TOKENS vocabulary.
value_in_object, find_entity, find_primitive_load, and find_entity_mut locate entities/values within model collections by id.
node_references collects all model references to a node id (used to block deletion of referenced nodes).
node_delete_display and pipe_delete_display build deletion summaries for nodes and pipe runs.
support_primitive_load_references, pipe_primitive_load_references, and load_case_combination_references collect dependent references that block deletion.
value_at, string_at, value_at_segments, and value_at_segments_mut traverse a JSON Value by string-path or segment list.
parse_finite_number parses a string into a finite f64, rejecting NaN/infinity.
display_number formats a number the way the inspector displays integers and short floats, for diagnostics/diff display only; staleness checks are numeric.

canonical_json (re-exported from open_pipe_stress_canonical_json) is the engine's single RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical form since H5: UTF-16-code-unit key sort, ECMAScript Number::toString rendering, JSON.stringify escaping; it is the sole canonicalization for every frontend hash seam (H1 / F-5a) with no TypeScript equivalent.
sha256_hex returns the lowercase-hex SHA-256 of a payload, public for the H1 / F-5a hash seam alongside canonical_json.
